CODE_DUPLICATE_FILE.fix: Each code must appear once. Change or delete one.

ITEM_TRACKED.reason: {code} is tracked by lot or serial.

PACK_QTY_INVALID.fix: Write pieces per carton as a whole number like 12.

PACK_QTY_TOO_SMALL.reason: Pieces per carton must be at least 2.

PACK_BARCODE_NEEDS_QTY.reason: There is a carton barcode but no pieces per carton.

BARCODE_INVALID.fix: Write only the barcode; no long QR text or special characters.

BARCODE_SAME_ROW.reason: The piece and carton barcodes are the same.

BARCODE_DUPLICATE_FILE.fix: Each barcode must belong to one product. Fix one.

BARCODE_TAKEN.reason: Barcode {value} is already saved on product {item}.
BARCODE_TAKEN.fix: Fix the barcode or leave the cell empty.

SHELF_MISSING.fix: Write the code of the shelf where the stock is.

SHELF_UNKNOWN.fix: Write the code exactly as on the warehouse screen, or add the shelf first.

SHELF_AMBIGUOUS.reason: Code {code} exists in more than one warehouse ({warehouses}).
SHELF_AMBIGUOUS.fix: Make shelf codes different between warehouses.

SHELF_KIND.fix: Choose a storage shelf to put stock on.

QTY_ZERO.fix: If there is no stock, delete the row.

QTY_AMBIGUOUS.reason: It is unclear whether {value} uses a thousands or decimal separator.

QTY_TOO_LARGE.reason: The quantity is too large or has too many digits ({value}).
QTY_TOO_LARGE.fix: Use at most 14 whole and 6 decimal digits.

PAIR_DUPLICATE_FILE.reason: This product and shelf are also on row {firstRow}.
PAIR_DUPLICATE_FILE.fix: Merge the two rows into one with the total quantity.
